name: EPIC 212311277
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 12.8 solar radii and 0.78 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,233 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.78 solar masses and 12.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,651 K at its surface.
